steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: What are those tall blue things by the road? Are they Fusang trees?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Those are anti-Mania bases designed to resist disasters.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Entymaniabysses... Sounds like a powerful artifact! We have artifacts with similar effects back home too, but... none of them has such a unique shape.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Ah! Could this be the fabled Celestial Pillar?!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Hmm? Haven't you all heard of the story of the Fall of Peril and the Azure Mender?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Oh, so it goes like this... A century ago, the Three-Eyed God fell from heaven to the mortal realm, intending to enlighten all living beings. But he slipped and landed headfirst and knocked himself unconscious.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: The Three-Eyed God fell into a deep slumber, but the hole in the sky remained. The essence of the ether poured through it like a waterfall, landing on earth as fires, deluges, droughts, thunder, vermin, and plagues.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: The hero of that era ventured into the forbidden land of the fallen god, took the iridescent crystals, and turned them into blue light pillars to support the collapsing sky. That's the tale of the Azure Mender!
She grabs the air in front of her vehemently as if about to reveal something incredible, but then draws back her hand to scratch her head after a moment's thought.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Ehehe... Sorry, I don't remember the rest. There are too many scriptures, and maybe the ending of this myth isn't known to us yet...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: But I'll keep working on my studies! Let me tell you some other stories, like the Ode to Sun or the Skymender Saga. They're really interesting!

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Yanyan, I'd love to hear all that when we finish our mission. As for now...

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: The power of the Sun Crow Apostle is formidable. Data shows that after it came into contact with BR-000, its influence spread rapidly and the previously suppressed Black Rings have also shown signs of revival.
An FAC soldier hands you the freshly prepared report and begins his briefing.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: Currently, BR-002 is being suppressed by the Eastian envoys and is stabilizing. However, its contamination still spreads up to a certain range, and approaching it is still risky.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: But if that's our target, the FAC will unconditionally take your orders and protect you... and this seer next to you too.
Trying his best to look professional, the FAC soldier's gaze sweeps over Yanyan and then on your clothes before darting away. Meanwhile, you feel uncomfortable in your new outfit.
An ear-piercing roar interrupts the awkward atmosphere in the car. A group of monsters you've never seen before appears in front of you.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Wow! Look ahead, and up in the sky... It's just like the myth!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: Chief, a new type of Corruptor has been detected! We believe it's a mutation caused by the High Tower Black Ring. They need to be eliminated immediately!
The FAC soldiers are ready for battle, but you're feeling a bit uncertain.
After the first encounter with the Sun Crow, you've been suffering the backlash from the shackles caused by the Sun Crow Apostle's Mania, and since then you've been feverish.
The Sinners in the Bureau have also been affected, running low fevers non-stop, as if you've passed it on to them through the shackles.
But Yanyan isn't showing any fear. In fact, she's watching the Corruptors emerging in front of her rather excitedly.

This is a type of Corruptor you've never seen before. Can you even call them Corruptors? They look grotesque, out of place just like that Draco that appeared once in your dreams, as if they don't belong in this world.

Could that really be some kind of mythical creature from Eastia?
...For a brief moment, this absurd thought crosses your mind.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: That's the Wraith Ape, imp bird, imp birdling, and little monkey. They are the Sun Crow's kin! Yanyan knows how to drive them away! Listen to me!
